# Best video editing tool or API for each job: cut, caption, dub, upscale

**An editing job on existing footage becomes the right service or FFmpeg route, an edit decision list and checked output.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_31f8ec6ef72a.webp" alt="One talking-head take exported four ways at once, 16:9, square, 4:5 and 9:16, each reframed on the speaker at her podcast desk." width="480"></p>

Which service to edit an existing video with, and how to edit it without breaking it. A routing guide for ten editing jobs: cut, trim, resize and join (FFmpeg, Rendi), talking-head cleanup (silence and filler cuts), long video to Shorts (OpusClip, or transcript + FFmpeg), captions and subtitles (ASS through FFmpeg, HyperFrames, Submagic), assembling from a timeline or template (HyperFrames, Shotstack), AI edits that restyle, swap people, relight or extend (varg Recast/Relight, Runway Aleph), dubbing and lip sync (HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Sync Labs), upscaling, slow motion and background removal (Topaz, Bria), finding moments and QA (Gemini, Twelve Labs), and handing off to Resolve, Premiere or Final Cut. Use when someone asks to edit, cut, trim, shorten, clip, reframe, caption, subtitle, translate, dub, lip-sync, upscale, restyle or clean up footage they already have, or asks which tool or API to edit video with. Not for making a video from a brief (varg-ai and the format skills).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-video-editing                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-video-editing --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Edit plan with a service per step |
| Needs | no API key |
| Uses | FFmpeg, varg API, HyperFrames, Remotion, OpusClip, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Topaz |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
